items.title_zh: 基因芯片技术在农作物育种中的开发及应用
items.summary: Gene chip biotechnology has emerged and been developed in the molecular breeding era. The rapid development of genomics, pan-genomics, molecular biology, and bioinformatics has driven the improvement and application of gene chip technology, supporting significant progress in crop genetics and evolutionary analysis, functional genomics research, and breeding applications. Gene chip technology is also integrated with traditional hybrid breeding and modern biological breeding technologies due to the high-throughput genotyping and high-precision marker detection capabilities, which greatly improve breeding efficiency and accuracy. More importantly, with the rapid development and practical application of big data and artificial intelligence technology, the deep integration of gene chips and intelligent breeding technologies will further improve the efficiency and precision of crop breeding a…

items.summary_zh: 基因芯片生物技术是在分子育种时代出现并发展起来的。基因组学、泛基因组学、分子生物学和生物信息学的快速发展，带动了基因芯片技术的完善和应用，支撑了作物遗传与进化分析、功能基因组学研究、育种应用等方面的重大进展。基因芯片技术还凭借高通量基因分型和高精度标记检测能力，与传统杂交育种和现代生物育种技术相结合，大大提高了育种效率和准确性。更重要的是，随着大数据和人工智能技术的快速发展和实际应用，基因芯片与智能育种技术的深度融合将进一步提高农作物育种和育种的效率和精准度。

While traditional molecular breeding has predominantly targeted protein-coding sequences, complete gene knockouts using conventional CRISPR-Cas9 often cause severe pleiotropic effects, such as growth retardation, reduced fertility, or lethality. In contrast, targeted editing of plant promoters enables the precise fine-tuning of gene expression. This approach allows for the optimization of specific agronomic traits while preserving essential gene functions, thereby generating continuous quantitative trait variations vital for crop domestication and improvement. items.title: Review and perspective of key generic technologies in crop phenomics

items.title: Quantum-sensing-enabled Chemical and Biological Metrology
items.title_zh: 量子传感化学和生物计量
items.summary: Quantum sensing is driving the chemical and biological measurements into a new era. This paper systematically introduces the underlying logic and representative systems of quantum chemical measurements. Quantum chemical measurement employs the superposition or entanglement of quantum systems—such as electrons，photons，atoms，and molecules—as probes. These probes are initialized，manipulated，and read out via optical and microwave techniques，enabling the transduction of physical-field signals generated by chemical and biological systems into precisely decodable quantum signals，and thereby allowing in situ，real-time，and high-precision measurement and imaging. This interdisciplinary direction achieves a deep integration of quantum physics，analytical chemistry，and biological physics，signifying a profound transformation of chemical metrology from classical measurements to quantum sensing.

items.title: Prospects for Combination Drug Development in Central Nervous System Disorders：From Multi-target Synergy to Personalized Precision Therapy
items.title_zh: 中枢神经系统疾病联合用药发展前景：从多靶点协同到个体化精准治疗
items.summary: The development of therapeutics for central nervous system （CNS） disorders is markedly lagging behind other disease areas，characterized by an exceptionally high failure rate in late-stage clinical trials. This review addresses the central challenge of creating effective combination therapies for complex CNS diseases，where single-target agents often fall short. First，we discuss modernizing Traditional Chinese Medicine （TCM） formulations by applying multi-omics and artificial intelligence to deconvolute their multi-component，multi-target mechanisms，thus transforming them into a source for rational drug combination discovery. items.summary: Target discovery，a core step in drug development，is currently facing a dual bottleneck. Current research efforts remain highly concentrated on a small number of validated targets，resulting in serious homogeneity across drug pipelines. At the same time，traditional experimental and computational approaches are limited in throughput，precision，and their capacity to identify multiple targets in complex and refractory diseases. To overcome these challenges，artificial intelligence （AI） is now transforming this landscape. items.title: From Single-target to System Remodeling：Combination Therapeutic Strategies for Metabolic Diseases
items.title_zh: 从单一靶点到系统重塑：代谢性疾病的联合治疗策略
items.summary: Metabolic diseases are characterized by complex pathological features involving multi-organ dysfunction and multi-pathway dysregulation. Therapeutic strategies targeting a single biomarker or pathway have shown limited effectiveness in halting disease progression. Taking type 2 diabetes mellitus （T2DM） as an example，the coexistence of hyperglycemia，insulin resistance，lipid metabolism disorders，and chronic inflammation leads to simultaneous damage across key systems such as the β-cell，liver，heart，and kidneys. However，current treatments primarily focus on glycemic control and lack systemic interventions that address multi-organ pathologies，resulting in persistently high rates of complications. items.summary: Promoting LNG cold energy utilization technology and building a multi energy complementary，clean，low-carbon，safe and efficient energy system are an important direction for the development of modern energy systems. This paper investigates and analyses the development status and trend of LNG cold energy utilization at home and abroad，focusing on the high-quality development layout of LNG cold energy utilization technology and clean energy system integration. Through energy matching and integration methods combined with economic and technical feasibility evaluation，this paper summarizes typical cases of LNG cold energy cascade utilization and multi-energy integrated utilization.
